n48e2f60586.headline: EasyJet takes £25m hit on surging fuel costs amid Middle East war
n48e2f60586.summary: EasyJet said it expects a half-year headline pre-tax loss of between £540 million and £560 million. It also reported a £25 million hit from surging fuel costs amid the Middle East war.
n48e2f60586.why: EasyJet is a Luton-based low-cost airline, so jet fuel prices feed directly into its operating costs and margins.

nca46857343.headline: Kenya raises retail fuel prices sharply amid Middle East conflict
nca46857343.summary: Kenya has raised retail fuel prices by as much as 24% as conflict in the Middle East drives up crude costs, according to a Nairobi report dated April 15, 2026.
nca46857343.why: Fuel prices feed into transport, food and inflation costs across Kenya's economy, shaping consumer spending and central bank policy.

nc02ccd106a.headline: Apartment prices could rise by more than seven percent this year
nc02ccd106a.summary: Apartment prices in the Czech Republic could rise by more than seven percent this year, according to Radio Prague International.
nc02ccd106a.why: House prices affect household wealth, mortgage demand and the inflation outlook that guides central bank rate decisions.

neaa7094ccc.headline: Protest restrictions struck down in 'win for democracy'
neaa7094ccc.summary: Bulgarians are voting in their eighth parliamentary election in five years as rising living costs, euro adoption and political instability fuel calls for stability and anti-corruption reform.
neaa7094ccc.why: Bulgaria adopted the euro recently, so political instability and fiscal policy choices matter to euro-area investors.

n5c5b6d8e78.headline: PM cuts short Asian fuel mission after refinery fire
n5c5b6d8e78.summary: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese will return to Australia early from overseas after a major blaze at one of the nation's refineries. The fire affects domestic fuel production.
n5c5b6d8e78.why: Refineries supply the bulk of Australia's fuel, so outages can tighten domestic petrol and diesel supply and raise pump prices.

na81a935d17.headline: Sensex, Nifty pare gains to end marginally lower, Adani Enterprises, Hindalco lead gainers
na81a935d17.summary: Indian stock markets ended marginally lower as profit-taking in financial shares pulled the Sensex and Nifty down from earlier gains. Adani Enterprises and Hindalco led the gainers.
na81a935d17.why: The BSE Sensex is the benchmark index of 30 large Indian companies, and the Nifty 50 is the National Stock Exchange's main benchmark.

n01811ce2b6.headline: Kenya: MPs Probe Fuel Quality in Kenya As Concerns Over Substandard Imports Grow
n01811ce2b6.summary: Kenya's Senate Energy Committee is examining fuel quality and regulatory oversight, after the Kenya Ports Authority detailed its handling of petroleum imports at the Port of Mombasa.
n01811ce2b6.why: Fuel import quality and port handling affect supply reliability, consumer prices and regulatory risk for fuel importers in East Africa.

nf2e46253b4.headline: Cut Fuel Prices by Kes. 27, Mp Nyoro Tells Government - Ghetto Radio
nf2e46253b4.summary: Kiharu MP Ndindi Nyoro is calling on the government to cut fuel prices by Ksh 27, arguing it is simple maths. The proposal concerns retail fuel costs in Kenya.
nf2e46253b4.why: Fuel prices feed into transport costs and inflation, so government pricing decisions affect businesses and households in Kenya.

source.name: Ghetto Radio - Kenya's Number 1 Ghetto Radio

sources.name: Ghetto Radio - Kenya's Number 1 Ghetto Radio

n85f86bc95e.headline: Fresh fuel supply fears hosed down after refinery blaze
n85f86bc95e.summary: Australia will rely more heavily on fuel imports after a fire at a refinery, caused by a suspected gas leak, damaged the facility. Officials have sought to ease fresh fuel supply fears.
n85f86bc95e.why: Refineries supply much of a country's transport fuel, so outages shift reliance onto imports and affect fuel prices and supply security.

n7bc5ff76dc.headline: Rwanda Secures Rwf370bn Funding to Support Economic Growth
n7bc5ff76dc.summary: Rwanda has secured a €213 million blended finance deal, about Rwf367 billion, backed by several international financial institutions. The Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning announced the deal.
n7bc5ff76dc.why: Blended finance combines public and private capital, and it is a key source of funding for development projects in low-income economies.

n5d1ca9a031.headline: But Wait, There’s More: IPOs Notch Standout Quarter as Giant Debuts Loom
n5d1ca9a031.summary: US IPOs had a standout quarter, and SpaceX's planned IPO, expected to be one of the largest public listings ever, could spur a wave of other listings.
n5d1ca9a031.why: IPO activity signals investor appetite for new equity and affects capital raising across sectors.

n1fc0bbd6d1.headline: LNG modelling NZ: Ombudsman complaint over secrecy
n1fc0bbd6d1.summary: A complaint to the Ombudsman has been lodged over the government's refusal to release modelling behind a $2.7 billion LNG project. The report questions what the government is withholding.
n1fc0bbd6d1.why: LNG projects involve large public and private capital commitments, and transparency over their economic modelling affects investment and energy policy decisions.

n35426a95bb.headline: Why gold, silver are rising on weak dollar & geopolitical tensions?
n35426a95bb.summary: Gold and silver prices rose amid a weak dollar and geopolitical tensions. Analysts expect near-term volatility ahead of Akshaya Tritiya.
n35426a95bb.why: Gold and silver are traditional safe-haven assets that often rise when the dollar weakens or geopolitical risk increases. Their prices feed into jewellery demand, central bank reserves and inflation hedging.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold prices rose as a weak dollar and geopolitical tensions increased safe-haven demand.

impacts.why: Silver prices rose alongside gold on the same dollar and geopolitical drivers.

nbacb34871a.headline: Rising Jet Fuel Prices Could Increase Your Next Flight’s Cost
nbacb34871a.summary: Jet fuel prices have doubled since the start of the conflict in Iran, which has disrupted fuel supply chains, and air travel is set to become more expensive worldwide.
nbacb34871a.why: Jet fuel is a major airline cost, and its price feeds directly into airline margins and passenger fares.

ne4056c72bc.headline: Volvo Cars to hike prices in India by up to Rs 1 lakh from May 1 amid supply chain and forex pressures
ne4056c72bc.summary: Volvo Cars will raise prices in India by up to Rs 1 lakh from May 1, citing supply chain disruptions and forex volatility, and more increases may follow.
ne4056c72bc.why: Volvo Cars is a Swedish carmaker, and its pricing in India reflects global supply costs and currency exposure.

n66ce0b54c2.headline: West Asia conflict hits aviation, tourism, inbound travel dips 15-20%, industry faces ₹18,000 cr loss: PHDCCI
n66ce0b54c2.summary: The West Asia conflict has reduced inbound travel to India by 15-20%, according to PHDCCI. The industry association estimates a ₹18,000 crore loss for the aviation and tourism sectors.
n66ce0b54c2.why: Aviation and tourism are highly sensitive to geopolitical shocks and fuel costs, and inbound travel is a key source of foreign-exchange earnings for India.

n22473ab397.headline: FIU-IND, SEBI sign MoU to strengthen anti-money laundering framework in India
n22473ab397.summary: India's Financial Intelligence Unit and the Securities and Exchange Board of India have signed a memorandum of understanding. The pact aims to boost intelligence sharing and anti-money laundering efforts.
n22473ab397.why: SEBI regulates India's securities markets, and stronger anti-money laundering cooperation affects compliance across listed firms and financial intermediaries.

n6b45be9341.headline: Foreign Investors Pull Out 73% of Their Money From Pakistan in 9 Months
n6b45be9341.summary: Total foreign investment in Pakistan fell 73% to $411 million in the nine months of FY2025-26, compared with $1.5 billion a year earlier. The data was shared by the authorities.
n6b45be9341.why: Foreign direct investment supports Pakistan's external finances and currency stability, so a steep decline is closely watched by investors.

n6b3bd9d66d.headline: Ample crude supply buffers US cargoes from price shock as Europe, Asia prices surge
n6b3bd9d66d.summary: The US imported 295,000 barrels per day of Venezuelan crude in the first quarter, up 14% on the year. Ample supply is buffering US cargoes as European and Asian prices surge.
n6b3bd9d66d.why: Crude import flows shape regional price spreads and refiners' feedstock choices, and the US is a major oil consumer.

n06fe158299.headline: IDC Data Shows First Smartphone Market Drop Since 2023
n06fe158299.summary: IDC reported a decline in global smartphone shipments for the first quarter, a return to negative growth after several quarters. The data covers the industry's largest handset volumes.
n06fe158299.why: Smartphone shipment trends indicate demand across the consumer electronics and chip supply chain, affecting handset makers and component suppliers.

nb526da058e.headline: iEdge Next 50 Liquidity Weighted Index outperforms STI on tech strength
nb526da058e.summary: The iEdge Next 50 Liquidity Weighted Index outperformed the STI on tech strength. It recorded a 9.7% year-to-date total return.
nb526da058e.why: The Straits Times Index is Singapore's benchmark stock index, and the iEdge Next 50 tracks a broader set of mid-cap Singapore-listed stocks.

nb83180c37f.headline: Mideast war an 'unprecedented' blow for region: IMF to AFP
nb83180c37f.summary: The IMF said the Middle East war is an 'unprecedented shock' for regional economies. Five of the Gulf's eight oil and gas producers face contraction this year, while Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Oman are expected to grow.
nb83180c37f.why: The IMF regional outlook shapes investor assessments of Gulf sovereign credit, budgets and energy-dependent growth.

source.name: AL-MONITOR: The Middle Eastʼs leading independent news source since 2012

sources.name: AL-MONITOR: The Middle Eastʼs leading independent news source since 2012

n433787762b.headline: New BYD Han EV sedan arrives at China dealers with flash charging and Blade Battery 2.0
n433787762b.summary: BYD's revised Han EV sedan, with flash charging and the Blade 2.0 battery, is arriving at dealers across China. The model update targets the domestic electric vehicle market.
n433787762b.why: BYD is one of the world's largest electric vehicle makers, so its model launches and battery technology shape competition in the EV market.

impacts.name: BYD
impacts.why: The revised model and battery technology are BYD's own product updates for its domestic sales.

nd34951c96f.headline: CATL's market cap exceeds 2 trillion yuan (290 billion USD), hits record high
nd34951c96f.summary: World's top battery maker CATL surpasses 2 trillion yuan (290 billion USD) in market capitalization, a record high. The company is the world's largest battery manufacturer.
nd34951c96f.why: CATL supplies batteries to many electric vehicle makers worldwide, so its valuation and output reflect demand for EV and energy storage batteries.

n2904832092.headline: Sen. Chiz  tells gov't: Use P14-B windfall from VAT on fuel for 'ayuda'
n2904832092.summary: Senator Francis Escudero urged the government to use a P14-billion windfall from value-added tax on petroleum products to fund direct financial aid.
n2904832092.why: VAT on fuel is a major revenue source for the Philippine government, and fiscal windfalls shape spending decisions.

n4ad5226a4c.headline: Pakistani army chief visits Tehran in bid to broker renewed US-Iran talks
n4ad5226a4c.summary: Pakistan has emerged as a key mediator after hosting direct talks between the US and Iran in Islamabad, and its army chief is now visiting Tehran.
n4ad5226a4c.why: Diplomatic mediation affects the likelihood of a durable settlement that would influence energy and shipping markets.

n33501b8983.headline: How South Korea plans to use the Iran crisis to spur a renewables revolution
n33501b8983.summary: The energy crisis in the Middle East has added political urgency and more funding to transform South Korea's solar industry, according to the Guardian.
n33501b8983.why: Energy security shocks often accelerate government funding for renewables, which benefits solar and wind suppliers.

n0fd828a3a9.headline: PM cuts short Asian fuel mission after refinery fire
n0fd828a3a9.summary: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese will return to Australia early from an Asian fuel mission after a major blaze at one of the nation's refineries.
n0fd828a3a9.why: Refineries convert crude into fuels, so outages can tighten domestic fuel supply and affect prices.

nde282b2d39.headline: Govt Accused of Forcing Pakistanis to Pay Tax on Property Income They Never Earned
nde282b2d39.summary: The Federal Constitutional Court was told that a tax on deemed income from immovable property under Section 7E was imposed on income property owners never earned.
nde282b2d39.why: Property tax rules affect real estate returns and government tax revenue in Pakistan.

n46b37f8036.headline: Sensex declines by 122 points, Nifty ends above 24,000
n46b37f8036.summary: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty climbed in early trade on Thursday on renewed optimism over restarting US-Iran negotiations, but Sensex ended lower while Nifty closed above 24,000.
n46b37f8036.why: The Sensex and Nifty 50 are the main benchmarks of India's stock market, tracking large listed companies on the BSE and NSE.

n3ae7ac24e0.headline: $3b Saudi support fuels robust PSX rally
n3ae7ac24e0.summary: Pakistan Stock Exchange rallied strongly on the back of $3 billion in Saudi support, according to The Express Tribune.
n3ae7ac24e0.why: The KSE-100 is the main benchmark of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, reflecting large listed companies in Pakistan's economy.
n3ae7ac24e0.why_moved: Input links the PSX rally to $3 billion in Saudi support, which supports Pakistan's external finances and investor sentiment.

n372b8917c7.headline: Hana Bank, Next Securities to offer real-time FX for foreign investors
n372b8917c7.summary: Hana Bank signed a memorandum of understanding with Next Securities to improve the trading environment for overseas investors in Korea's stock market, including real-time foreign exchange.
n372b8917c7.why: Hana Bank is a major South Korean lender, and real-time FX access eases settlement and trading for foreign investors in Korean equities.

n14055b7d71.headline: Indonesian Navy to adopt B50 fuel for patrol efficiency
n14055b7d71.summary: Indonesia's Navy plans to use B50 fuel for its patrol vessels to improve fuel efficiency, the Navy chief said on Thursday, as part of broader efforts to cut costs.
n14055b7d71.why: B50 is a biodiesel blend with a high palm-oil-derived share, so state fuel use shapes domestic demand for biofuel feedstock and the country's energy import needs.
